title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Improper Authorization… (CVE-2026-91901)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 have an improper authorization vulnerability in the handler for a custom URL scheme. This flaw could allow a low privileged attacker with remote access to perform client-side request forgery (CSRF). The vulnerability has a low severity rating and a CVSS score of 3.5.
